scale_note: Nominal block width approximately 4 mm. Representative glands, receptors, vessel calibres and cellular details are magnified; counts are not densities. Cell ribbons and ducts are teaching representatives, not measured rows, flow, tissue optics or receptor receptive-field sizes.

native_contract.animation_status: Manual caption/camera/visibility/selection progression only; no morph animation, flow particles, stimulus deformation or simulated spikes.
native_contract.variant_contract: Configure independently selected machine variant_id pre_refine or post_refine, displaying Pre refine or Post refine, with the verified native-cache SHA-256 before ProceduralModel. Restore before variant switching; default requires every final recipe selector. Legacy metadata compatibility is explicit, never delivery-ready.

views.purpose: Locate the surface, stratified epidermis, vascular dermis and deep sensory/glandular context.
Follow basal to superficial differentiation; each layer has representative cell organization.
Retain tissue and trace one eccrine unit to its surface pore.
Hide host slabs for duct continuity inspection, including from the reverse side.
Keep capillary loops and living lower epidermis together to distinguish intravascular flow from diffusion.
Compare superficial Meissner/free endings and deep Pacinian capsule with its incoming axon.
Hide the lamellae while preserving the terminal, incoming nerve and deep connective context. Capsule removal is a teaching dissection.
Review the same continuous eccrine route from the reverse side; host tissue removal is an anatomical teaching dissection.
Relate basal melanocyte somata and dendrites to neighboring living keratinocytes.

functional_sequences.mechanism: A differentiating keratinocyte population builds and renews a cornified surface barrier.

steps.caption: Basal cells divide; differentiating progeny move toward the surface.
Spinous keratinocytes maintain desmosomal contacts and keratin filaments.
Granular cells show cytoplasmic keratohyalin granules. Separate lamellar organelles supply extracellular barrier material; they are not the same granules.
Cells lose nuclei and organelles; lucidum is the pale transition band characteristic of very thick epidermis.
Flattened corneocytes and extracellular lipids form the barrier; superficial cells are shed as renewal continues.

schematic_limitations: Stages are compressed into a manual teaching sequence; no simulated cell motion or universal four-week clock.
Cell counts, molecular granules and lipid organization are representative and magnified.
Hiding a layer or separating layers creates a dissection gap, not disease or a physiological state.
Lamellar secretion and tight-junction establishment overlap; do not model them as mutually exclusive switches.
No lamellar-body mesh, lipid bilayer, tight-junction network, mitosis, desquamation or permeability simulation is supplied. These processes are explained in captions.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Sympathetic cholinergic stimulation promotes primary secretion; ductal salt reabsorption modifies fluid before the epidermal passage and pore.

steps.caption: The deep secretory coil lies near local blood supply; sympathetic cholinergic input stimulates secretion.
Clear secretory cells generate nearly isotonic primary fluid in the lumen. Dark cells and surrounding myoepithelial cells have distinct identities.
Human isolated-gland experiments show cholinergically evoked segmental myoepithelial contraction contributing to transport. This model shows the basket statically.
Na+ and Cl- move from the duct lumen across absorptive epithelium. ENaC and CFTR support salt conservation.
Relatively little accompanying water is reabsorbed, so final sweat is usually hypotonic. The same lumen continues through the acrosyringium.
The same duct continues through epidermis to its pore. Reverse-side isolation checks anatomical continuity; changing the view does not animate sweat.
Fluid exits at the sweat pore on a friction ridge. Evaporation can remove heat; palmar/plantar sweating also responds to nonthermal stimuli.

schematic_limitations: No cyclic contraction or squeeze-driven geometry is implemented. The 2023 ex vivo human study supports a myoepithelial transport contribution, not the only source of fluid or a universal model pump waveform.
Sweat concentration varies with flow and physiology; no fixed mmol/L values, clinical thresholds or fluid speed.
Flow arrows must lie inside the shared lumen; salt-reabsorption arrows cross the duct wall into interstitium.
Acrosyringium and dermal duct retain one original selector. The lumen domain is optional schematic fluid volume, not a flow tracer, tissue plug or epithelium.
Transport channels and secretion chemistry are caption-level explanation, not rendered channels or a quantitative electrolyte calculation.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Dermal capillary exchange supports avascular living epidermis.

steps.caption: Arteriolar inflow reaches the superficial network and papillary capillary loops.
Capillary exchange occurs within dermal papillae. Oxygen and nutrients diffuse through interstitium toward living epidermal cells.
Blood returns through venous channels; epidermal renewal relies on dermal supply, without epidermal blood vessels.

schematic_limitations: Blood movement and diffusion require distinct arrows; diffusion is not a tubular vascular continuation.
No oxygen-distance threshold, quantitative concentration field or capillary density is inferred from representative loops.
Any basal interface outline is an explanatory boundary, not a third vascular compartment.
Existing blood-vessel hosts show vascular courses; they are solid-envelope teaching meshes, not demonstrated hollow lumens. No blood particles or diffusion arrows are implemented.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Dynamic deformation produces tactile afferent activity; rapidly adapting receptors reduce firing during a static hold.

steps.caption: Locate superficial papillary corpuscles, free terminal branches and the deeper lamellar Pacinian structure.
Changing contact evokes transient activity in rapidly adapting tactile afferents. Read this as a physiological explanation; no indentation or firing animation is present.
During a maintained indentation the rapidly adapting response diminishes. These two receptor examples do not represent every tactile receptor class.
Capsule removal exposes the terminal and incoming axon. This anatomical isolation does not simulate denervation or predict the response of a decapsulated receptor.
Release or renewed deformation can recruit another transient response. Repeated vibration is a changing stimulus, not a travelling material bead.

schematic_limitations: No response pulses, calibrated spikes, imposed indentation, vibration frequency or deformation is implemented; the sequence only changes view and selection.
Pacinian mechanochemical experiments used isolated cat mesenteric receptors; they qualify the capsule-only explanation rather than establish human palm neurochemistry.
Free endings are not assigned the same rapid-adaptation waveform; pain, temperature and itch pathways are outside this tactile sequence.
Merkel and Ruffini receptor classes are not separately represented in the input cache.

functional_sequences.mechanism: Basal melanocytes supply pigment to neighboring keratinocytes through dendritic relationships.

steps.caption: Locate melanocyte bodies at the basal epidermis and dendrites between neighboring keratinocytes.
Pigment-containing organelles are conveyed along dendrites and transferred to neighboring keratinocytes; the model exposes spatial relationships only.
Pigment in keratinocytes helps shield nuclei from ultraviolet damage. The mesh does not simulate ultraviolet exposure or melanosome transfer.

schematic_limitations: Melanosome transport, transfer route, synthesis and supranuclear caps are not separately rendered or animated.
Three representative melanocyte somata do not state density, skin color, ancestry or ultraviolet susceptibility.
Dendrite-tip markers are illustrative contact context, not proof of a measured individual cell-to-cell transfer event.

Cell profile and barrier granule identity at useful close-up.
Pacinian incoming axon remains connected when capsule is hidden.
Saved cache metadata and descriptions agree with actual representative counts.
Independent native cache identity and metadata check for each Pre refine/Post refine variant; both must retain exact semantic selectors.
